text.zh: 10.24 程序员日看到一张「代码猜诗词」的图，作者把十段代码逐一解回诗句，并说明代码怎么对上诗意、诗句出自哪里。比如 cutWater(getKnife())(water++) 是「抽刀断水水更流」，hold ? fish : palm 是「鱼与熊掌不可兼得」，视野不到一千就 building.level++ 的是「欲穷千里目，更上一层楼」。
text.en: On Programmers' Day, October 24, the author found a puzzle that hides lines of Chinese poetry in code, and decodes all ten, explaining how each snippet maps onto its line and where the line comes from. cutWater(getKnife())(water++) is Li Bai's “draw a knife to cut the water, and it flows on”; hold ? fish : palm is Mencius's “you can't have both the fish and the bear's paw”; raising building.level while the view is under 1000 is “climb one more floor to see a thousand li”.
